title: National Investigation Agency v. Ranjan Daimary & Ors. (Assam Serial Blasts)
crime_type: Synchronized Multi-District Vehicle Bombings / Separatist Insurgency / Mass Casualties
court_or_authority: Special CBI / NIA Sessions Court Guwahati / Gauhati High Court
legal_citation: Special NIA Case No. 1/2009; 2020 SCC OnLine Gau 4412
source: Special Court Guwahati Judgment & Indian Kanoon
ipc_sections: Section 121 IPC (Waging war against the Government of India)
location: Guwahati, Kokrajhar, Barpeta Road & Bongaigaon, Assam, India
evidence: Simultaneous detonation of 18 vehicle-borne improvised explosive devices (VBIED) in cars and motorcycles within a 20-minute span
Chemical detection of RDX, Ammonium Nitrate, and fuel oil slurry in crater residue at Ganeshguri flyover and Panbazar
Confession of bomb assembler detailing procurement of chemicals through cross-border camps in Bangladesh
Engine chassis numbers of exploded Maruti 800 cars traced to purchased stolen vehicles
modus_operandi: Separatist insurgent group procured stolen hatchback cars and motorcycles. Fitted trunks with heavy ammonium nitrate and RDX fuel-slurry charges wired to digital timer clocks. Parked vehicles under crowded flyovers, vegetable markets, and near district court premises, triggering detonations simultaneously at 11:30 AM.
personality_disorder: Insurgent ideological fanaticism, ruthless indifference to non-combatant casualties, and militant hierarchy.
common_traits: Ammonium nitrate, fuel oil, and RDX compound cocktails
Cross-border command sanctuaries in neighboring countries
Targeting crowded civilian markets and judicial court grounds
summary: The worst terror incident in Northeast Indian history, killing 88 civilians and injuring 540. The Special CBI/NIA Court convicted NDFB chief Ranjan Daimary and 14 others to life imprisonment in 2019.
